status: The frozen source's confidence weakly enriches for searched first-action disagreements, but simple confidence routing leaves many disagreements unqueried; no controller was built or promoted.

data.teacher_label: First action of the native three-turn searched whole-turn plan; the cached and replanned search have the same first action when queried on the same root state

uniform_query_expectation: A label-independent quarter or half of positions would capture approximately 25 or 50 percent of disagreements. Both confidence signals provide modest enrichment, not a demonstrated game-strength or latency benefit.
stratification: The raw audit contains root-seat and legal-action-count strata for every fixed budget. Of 587 roots, 516 have at least 17 legal actions and 329 of the 360 source-teacher disagreements occur in that stratum. At the quarter-budget margin ranking, 223 of those 329 disagreements remain unqueried.
verification: Replay covered all128 maps and both seats; every teacher label was locally legal. The final audit reproduced byte-for-byte in a second run. Both runs used one pinned nice19 CPU on the SSH server; Python465 tests and Ruff passed there.
interpretation: Teacher first-action disagreement is not terminal harm. This post hoc audit uses previously inspected fit maps and neither calibrates a threshold nor tests a policy. The simple single-model confidence idea does not yet justify a new complete-game evaluation or replacement of the validated full native search. The failed full-episode neural student and earlier slower two-model selective controller remain rejected; no rated or owner-private Site agent changed.
